label: neiso 56 reserve coopt
definition: NEISO keeper (promoted 2026-07-09, owner decision, rule-1 structural fidelity). The neiso-55 recipe + energy_reserve_coopt — ISO-NE system-wide energy+reserve co-optimization with the published 3-level nested RCPF demand curves (total-30-min 1,800 MW @ $1,000, total-10-min 1,200 MW @ $1,500, 10-min-spin 600 MW @ $50; Market Rule 1 §III.2.7A), storage reserve-eligible. The mechanism is DORMANT on 2023-2025 (reserve dual $0.00 in all 26,280 hours; kept although it moves no backcast metric — the winter-fuel-stack precedent): fit is byte-comparable to neiso-55 and the determination is identical, CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (C2 commercial-band; C3c/C5b ledgered — both closure paths now proven dormant, the caveats are irreducible on the train years by any admissible mechanism identified to date).
market_story: energy_reserve_coopt adds the real ISO-NE clearing structure: energy and operating reserves co-optimize against the published nested RCPF demand curves, and a reserve-short hour would stack the penalty factor into the LMP while paying reserve value to storage. On 2023-2025 the ample NEISO fleet clears the 1,800/1,200/600 MW requirements out of idle thermal headroom at zero opportunity cost in every hour — even the January-2025 cold-snap hours with the gas cold-snap derate active — so the mechanism prices nothing and moves nothing: keeper-vs-twin class deltas are the same small floor effects as the neiso-55 pair, with the reserve dual $0.00 in both arms.
